prompt: Role: independent engineering-workflow critic. Current CLAUDE.md explicitly defines Producer -> Critic -> Fixer -> Independent Verifier -> Gate -> Evidence; bounded agent briefs with node, role, acceptance criteria, allowed paths, minimal context, exact commands, evidence destination and forbidden actions; exact failure output is passed to fixers; generated changes require diff review, regression, and independent verification; failed/rejected reviews are retained; tool provenance cannot be fabricated. Current plan.md maps all five rubric weights to concrete evidence and claim boundaries, keeps scope cuts explicit, and states that workflow artifacts do not prove a named tool executed. Project commands for lint/typecheck/test/build/e2e/graph are concrete. Decide whether these root documents are sufficiently opinionated and review-ready without adding generic boilerplate. First line VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED, then at most three concise findings.
